Requiring a successor to annotate a frozen predecessor's defect, when the disclosure already sits in a verdict the successor pins, would be over-reach.

The propagation boundary is the part of this fold worth noticing. The correction had to reach exactly four of nine obligations, and a blunt substitution would have stamped the owner onto the two leftover-design obligations whose owner is legitimately 'none' — which would have quietly asserted that unauthored fixture work has a live owner today, converting an owner fix into a standing claim. The five untouched obligations are byte-identical, so that did not happen.
